1. Provide JulesSessionGetReader(existing_key) with read_completed_session(session_id, *, expected_branch, expected_create_time, expected_pr) returning only the needed Session resource fields (name, createTime, state, sourceContext, outputs; optional validated updateTime). 2. Validate all expected inputs before I/O: ASCII numeric nonempty session_id, safe exact non-default isolated jules-work branch, aware expected_create_time, type(expected_pr) is int and >0. Invalid inputs cause zero open calls.
3. Exactly one bounded HTTPS GET to https://jules.googleapis.com/v1alpha/sessions/<numeric-id>, X-Goog-Api-Key containing only the injected existing key. Finite timeout=30, bounded response <=1MiB, no redirects or retries. Never allow caller URL/host/query selection.

5. Require outputs list with exactly ONE pullRequest object and URL exactly https://github.com/kamiyusense/multi-ai-council-phase0/pull/<expected_pr>. Reject missing, duplicate, extra other PR, malformed output, wrong repo/PR. Do not infer a result from actor/title/branch. Pending/nonterminal is a bounded unavailable result, never PASS.
6. Expected identity/time mismatches, malformed JSON/types, HTTP/auth/429/500/timeout/oversize/redirect are fail-closed ValueError with a fixed safe message; no raw exception/body/key in message or chained displayed cause. Do not catch KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit.
7. Returned structures are isolated copies/projections. No filesystem/state/claim/command/review write or model execution. This reader is not the existing RUNNING-only runtime authenticator; do not change that protocol.

- empty/Unicode/non-numeric/traversal/control session ID; default/non-isolated/unsafe branch; bool PR; naive/future? Do not invent current-time policy; expected aware time only.
- wrong name, repo, branch, createTime, malformed nested context, pending/FAILED Session state.
- missing/duplicate/foreign/non-object PR outputs; malformed JSON/duplicate keys; large response; HTTP 401/429/500, timeout, redirect.
- failure text containing mock key/raw secret must be sanitized; request key must not appear in return/repr/errors; input not mutated; repeated failures do not resend.
